title: Car Charger
description: An EV charger. Starting a charge raises the home's live power draw by its wattage and its monthly usage by its per-cycle energy; stopping lowers the power draw again. Both are cross-Thing effects, idempotent so a repeated start or stop does not double-count.

startCharging.title: Start Charging
startCharging.vre:effects: const home = <home>; home.currentPowerUsageW' = home.currentPowerUsageW + (isCharging ? 0 : powerWatts); home.currentMonthUsageKWh' = home.currentMonthUsageKWh + (isCharging ? 0 : kwhPerCycle); isCharging' = true; output.success = true; output.isCharging = isCharging';

stopCharging.title: Stop Charging
stopCharging.vre:effects: const home = <home>; home.currentPowerUsageW' = home.currentPowerUsageW - (isCharging ? powerWatts : 0); isCharging' = false; output.success = true; output.isCharging = isCharging';
